messages.subject: Error in data import
parts:
What is going wring in importing the file with these code? Can this imported data be used in DAPC?

mova<-read.genalex ("~/Desktop/HARENDRA/genolax114.csv", ploidy = 2, geo = FALSE, region = FALSE,  genclone = TRUE, sep = ",", recode = FALSE)
Error in .local(.Object, ...) :
  more than one '.' in column names; please name column as [LOCUS].[ALLELE]
In addition: Warning message:
In df2genind(gena2, sep = "/", ind.names = ind.vec, pop = pop.vec,  :
  character '.' detected in names of loci; replacing with '_'

messages.author: d192ec4b1d416345
messages.subject: Re: [poppr] Error in data import
parts:
Hi, this error appears because you have duplicated locus names in your data, specifically:

"RM22"  "RM127"

If you rename these loci, your data should import correctly. In a future version of poppr, I will make sure the error message is more explicit.

Zhian
